verdict.rationale: GitHub supports background automations via Actions/CI-CD (docs-11), Dependabot-style dependency and secret remediation (docs-5,6,7,15), and Copilot coding agent that can be assigned tasks and PR reviews asynchronously from a project board or mobile device (docs-4,9,14). This covers both classic CI/CD automation and newer agentic task assignment running without live supervision. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence that assigned Copilot agent tasks reliably complete unattended end-to-end, and detailed docs on scheduling/triggers for these background jobs.
